title: Catalytic valorization of polyolefins: from catalysts and processes to reactors
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS01390A, Review Article
Cuncun Wu, Chaojie Guo, Xinquan Xu, Kun Liu, Lingyu Bai, Nan Yang, Donglong Fu, Jinlong Gong
This review describes progress in catalytic valorization of polyolefins across length scales, connecting active-site chemistry, process development and optimization, and reactor selection and design.
